title: MetadataMatchCandidatesPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'metadata.match-candidates'. Phosphor retheme Wave 2 (Lane L2, Fix Match): emitted once by the 'metadata-search' job handler (apps/worker/src/metadata/match-search-consumer.ts) after it has finished a bounded provider-chain search for one item — CLAUDE.md invariant 6 means the search itself runs in the worker, never inline in the POST /admin/items/{id}/match-search request path. ADMIN-ONLY delivery (ws-broadcaster.service.ts ADMIN_ONLY_TYPES), mirroring job.updated/settings.updated exactly: candidate titles/years are catalog data an admin's own restricted-content clearance already gates elsewhere, and this event carries no per-viewer redaction of its own — treat it the same as any other admin-only operational event, not as a content-list surface a non-admin could ever legitimately receive.

itemId.description: The catalog item this search was run for.

jobId.description: The 'metadata-search' job that produced this result — lets a client that enqueued several searches match results back to the right item.

candidates.description: Every result found across the item's resolved provider chain, ranked best-first (apps/worker/src/metadata/match.ts's title/year scoring, normalized 0-100). Empty when no provider in the chain returned any result.

isBest.description: True for exactly one candidate (the highest-scored) when candidates is non-empty; false for every candidate when candidates is empty.
